text.tspan: Securing a cluster: 7 layers, say them in this order
authentication → RBAC → admission (Pod Security, Kyverno, ValidatingAdmissionPolicy)
ServiceAccounts, short-lived projected tokens, IRSA / Pod Identity for AWS
Pod Security Standards (restricted), securityContext: non-root, drop ALL, read-only FS
default-deny NetworkPolicy, private API endpoint, mTLS with a service mesh
scan (Trivy), sign (cosign), verify signatures and trusted registries at admission
KMS encryption at rest, external secret manager, tight RBAC on secrets
audit logs, Falco / GuardDuty runtime alerts, kube-bench (CIS benchmark)
Dangerous RBAC: get/list secrets · create pods · pods/exec · escalate / bind / impersonate · nodes/proxy · wildcards *
